subject.title: fix(agents): cap sessions_list tool limit before gateway dispatch

question: Should `sessions_list` adopt an explicit model-facing pagination contract before its existing valid `limit` values are capped at 1,000?
rationale: The safe fix needs an additive input/output contract for model continuation; silently truncating an established tool result is a compatibility decision that source review cannot make on behalf of maintainers.

options.title: Add explicit pagination
options.body: Add a bounded page limit, an additive continuation input, returned cursor/has-more metadata, and coverage proving all visible sessions remain reachable.

options.title: Preserve existing behavior
options.body: Leave the agent-tool limit unbounded until maintainers choose and document a pagination contract.

recommendation.title: Add explicit pagination
recommendation.body: Add a bounded page limit, an additive continuation input, returned cursor/has-more metadata, and coverage proving all visible sessions remain reachable.

likelyOwner.reason: Low-confidence routing candidate for the agent-tool contract decision.
